<title level="1" pfs="">[Pale Horse](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3319)</title>

<row gap="medium">

<column gap="medium" flex="1 1 400px">

The death of a unicorn in a particularly cruel manner leads to the creation of a pale horse—a symbol of hope and purity transformed into one of hopelessness and despair.

<column gap="tiny">
**[Recall Knowledge - Undead](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**
([Religion](/Skills.aspx?ID=46)): DC 30

**[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 28

**[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 25
</column>

</column>

<column gap="medium">

</column>

</row>

<title level="2" right="Creature 11">[Pale Horse](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3319)</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=721" />
<trait label="Large" />
<trait label="Incorporeal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=632" />
<trait label="Undead" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=722" />
<trait label="Unholy" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=521" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 190

**Perception** +21; [darkvision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=59), [lifesense](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=67) 90 feet

**Languages**
[Common](/Languages.aspx?ID=1), [Fey](/Languages.aspx?ID=119), [Necril](/Languages.aspx?ID=20); can't speak any language

**Skills**
[Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=34) +26, [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=40) +20, [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=48) +23

<row gap="medium">
**Str** -5

**Dex** +8

**Con** +3

**Int** -2

**Wis** +4

**Cha** +3
</row>

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

<row gap="medium">
**AC** 30 

**Fort** +20 

**Ref** +24 

**Will** +21 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**HP** 180
([void healing](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=83))

</row>

**Immunities**
[death](/Traits.aspx?ID=571) effects, [disease](/Traits.aspx?ID=578), [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=647), [paralyzed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=85), [poison](/Traits.aspx?ID=669), [unconscious](/Conditions.aspx?ID=95)

**Resistances**
all damage 10 (except [force](/Traits.aspx?ID=610), [_ghost touch_](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2840), or [vitality](/Traits.aspx?ID=509); double resistance vs. non- &lt;%traits%644%%&gt; magical &lt;%end>)

**Aura of Despair** ([aura](/Traits.aspx?ID=542), [emotion](/Traits.aspx?ID=590), [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=647)) 30 feet. A living creature that begins its turn in the aura must succeed at a DC 27 Will save or become [slowed 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=92). A creature is temporarily immune to the aura for 1 hour if it critically succeeds.

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

**Speed** fly 45 feet

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
spectral horn +24 ([Finesse](/Traits.aspx?ID=179), [Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103)),
**Damage** 3d10+10 void

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
hoof +24 ([Agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170), [Finesse](/Traits.aspx?ID=179), [Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103)),
**Damage** 3d8+10 void

**Occult Innate Spells** DC 27
- **2nd**
[Darkness](/Spells.aspx?ID=59) (at will)
- **4th**
[Harm](/Spells.aspx?ID=146) (×3)
- **5th**
[Toxic Cloud](/Spells.aspx?ID=1722), [Translocate](/Spells.aspx?ID=1724)

**Spectral Charge** <actions string="Two Actions" />  The pale horse [Flies](/Actions.aspx?ID=2312) twice and then makes a horn Strike. The pale horse can move through creatures.

</column>
